blocks.content: Quiz: A developer writes this Claude Code prompt: "Build the dashboard page with charts and stats." What is the most critical problem with this prompt?
Tap an option below to answer:
It does not specify which CSS framework to use for the dashboard
While specifying the CSS framework is part of the tech stack section, the absence of CSS framework info is a smaller problem compared to the complete lack of behavioral specification.
While specifying the CSS framework is part of the tech stack section, the absence of CSS framework info is a smaller problem compared to the complete lack of behavioral specification.
It contains no context about the existing codebase, no file structure, and no behavior specification

Correct. Without context, Claude Code does not know what already exists. Without a behavior spec, it will invent component behavior. Without file paths, it may create files in the wrong places. All three cause rework.

Correct. Without context, Claude Code does not know what already exists. Without a behavior spec, it will invent component behavior. Without file paths, it may create files in the wrong places. All three cause rework.
It is too short to be processed by Claude Code
Claude Code processes prompts of any length. A short prompt is not a technical problem - it is a content problem. The issue is what is missing, not the character count.
Claude Code processes prompts of any length. A short prompt is not a technical problem - it is a content problem. The issue is what is missing, not the character count.
It should be split into two separate chunks - one for charts and one for stats
Charts and stats can reasonably be one chunk if they are on the same page. The problem is not the scope - it is the complete absence of context, file structure, and behavior specs.
Charts and stats can reasonably be one chunk if they are on the same page. The problem is not the scope - it is the complete absence of context, file structure, and behavior specs.
